source.repo: empathiq-website (archived copy — real repo never modified)
source.materialization: git archive <pin> | tar -x into disposable tree; node_modules symlinked (same pattern as sealed EXP-0011 run-arm.mjs)

derivation_rule: Stated before any error inspection: subsystems = top-level dirs under server/ ranked by total baseline error count, EXCLUDING governance and mcp (EXP-0011 disjointness); top 2 remaining = S1 (higher), S2; within each, top 3 files by in-subsystem error count desc, tie alphabetical; positions p1..p3 in that order.

amendment.ground: pre-existing owner quarantine of the historical coherence-field source (registry: located, not copied, not wired, no authority). Building EXP-0013 evidence stores and worker tasks from quarantined source would entangle experiment artifacts with it.
amendment.honesty: rule-statement defect disclosed, not a silent swap: the exclusion ground predates the rule statement; the amendment was decided on subsystem IDENTITY only — no error content was examined in making it.
amendment.effect: selection shifted from {emotional-geometry-runtime, deployment} to {deployment, agent}

disjointness.disclosure: S2 (agent) errors all fall under server/agent/mcp/ — a distinct directory tree from EXP-0011 server/mcp/ with zero file overlap, satisfying the frozen rule; the thematic resemblance (MCP-related code) is recorded rather than hidden.

treatment_blindness: Selection used error COUNTS and subsystem identity only. No error content, no file content, and no fix difficulty was examined before selection was fixed.
